name: Landsat TOA, all scenes, water-masked
description: Landsat 5, Landsat 7 before its 2003 scan-line failure, and Landsat 8; top-of-atmosphere reflectance; every scene kept with cloudy pixels masked; pixels covered by water at least half the time masked; 2012 windows filled from 2013; 30 m; no coverage rescue; mean and maximum composites in every date mode; growing season May-September in the per-year mode.
